_notice: DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE CHECKLIST. Not the official eight-criterion checklist: criteria, weights, scales and rules here are placeholders that exercise every feature (answer types, sections, N/A, severe errors). Replace it with the official checklist once it is supplied.
name: Development sample checklist (unofficial)
description: Placeholder criteria for testing the product. Not the official checklist; do not present its scores as quality results.

criteria.name: Greeting (sample)
criteria.description: Sample criterion: the operator greets the client in their first message.
criteria.na_rule: Sample rule: no operator joined the conversation.

criteria.name: Introduces themselves (sample)
criteria.description: Sample criterion: the operator gives their name.
criteria.na_rule: Sample rule: no operator joined the conversation.

criteria.name: Identifies the need (sample)
criteria.description: Sample criterion: how well the operator establishes what the client needs, 0–5.

criteria.name: Correct solution (sample)
criteria.description: Sample criterion: the information or action given solves the client's request.
criteria.severe_error_rule: Sample rule: wrong information that could cause the client a financial loss.

criteria.name: Offers further help (sample)
criteria.description: Sample criterion: the operator asks whether anything else is needed.
criteria.na_rule: Sample rule: the client ended the conversation first.

criteria.name: Farewell (sample)
criteria.description: Sample criterion: the operator closes politely.
criteria.na_rule: Sample rule: the client ended the conversation first.
